user.title: Connect to the inverter proxy
user.description:
Enter the proxy address. Home Assistant checks that the proxy is reachable, reads the inverter address from the existing GoodWe integration, hands that address to the proxy, and then points GoodWe at the proxy instead of the inverter.

Automatic fallback: if the proxy is unavailable for more than 5 minutes and the inverter itself still answers, Home Assistant temporarily points GoodWe back to the inverter so you keep seeing its status. When the proxy returns, Home Assistant switches back automatically. Removing this integration restores the original GoodWe address.

data.inverter_host: Inverter IP address (override, normally detected automatically)

select_goodwe.title: Select GoodWe integration
select_goodwe.description: Choose the GoodWe integration entry that should use the proxy.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the proxy control API. Check the IP and that the proxy is running.
error.no_goodwe: No GoodWe integration is configured. Set it up first, then add the proxy.
error.configure_failed: The proxy did not accept the inverter address.
error.inverter_unreachable: Neither the GoodWe integration address nor the proxy's configured inverter address answered. Enter the inverter IP address manually.

abort.already_configured: This proxy is already configured for this GoodWe integration.
